title: Billiards, Refraction, and Blow-Up for Kirchhoff Equations
summary: We start from a simple problem in geometric optics. A particle moves between two homothetic ellipses, with refraction at the inner interface and reflection at the outer one. In a suitable nearly circular regime, the small geometric anisotropy of the ellipses is amplified by the strong refraction, and the corresponding return map develops a transverse heteroclinic connection between the two axial motions.
